description: This file defines the MarkAttendanceScreen widget, a placeholder UI component for marking attendance in a real-time attendance system. It includes a scaffold with a message indicating no session is selected and a button to start a new session.

classes.name: MarkAttendanceScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget serving as a placeholder UI for marking attendance, with a scaffold containing a message and a button to start a new session.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MarkAttendanceScreen, including the OceanScaffold with title, body, and floating action button.
